record_kind: pm-maintained task reporting contract; not executable harness configuration

field_contract.unknown_values: null means unavailable/unknown, never measured zero; set identity and applicable contract fields before dispatch
field_contract.milestones: Each item: id, deliverable, weight, state, evidence_refs. Weights sum to 1 and include required validation/acceptance with positive weights.
field_contract.scope_weight: Stable agreed share of leaf scope, not recalculated from token spend. Parent summaries do not add child scope again.
field_contract.allowance: authority identifies an existing user/project cap or a PM planning threshold; source_ref links its real basis
field_contract.reports: Append task_id, agent_id, reported_at (timezone), status, progress, completed_milestones, evidence_refs, current_activity, remaining_work, token_usage, remaining_tokens low/high, remaining_active_minutes low/high, waits, expected_finish earliest/latest or unknown reason, blockers, confidence, next_action, next_checkpoint.
field_contract.token_usage: Each report separates measured_tokens (null if unavailable), estimated_unmeasured_tokens low/high, source, observed_at, coverage, cumulative_or_delta, counter_epoch and coverage_gaps; preserve raw counters and avoid subset/parent-child double counting.
field_contract.forecast_revisions: Append timestamp, previous/current token and time forecasts, changed assumptions, reason and PM decision reference; retain initial estimates for both tokens and time.
field_contract.pm_decisions: Append timestamp, decision, scope, reason, owner and authorization/limit reference when applicable.
field_contract.closure: Record closed_at, outcome, evidence_refs, model, actual work units/context/reuse, verification and correction counts, actual active/wait durations, measured tokens/source/coverage or unavailable, estimated unmeasured tokens separately, original/final forecasts, matched-coverage estimate errors/reasons and next-estimate calibration notes. Failed/cancelled costs remain risk evidence.
field_contract.project_rollup: Read task records and harness acceptance state; include distinct PM/integration/QC cost owners and a single explicit contingency, retain cap source, missing telemetry coverage, baseline scope weights, dependency/resource finish calculation and next checkpoint. No duplicate parent costs or second acceptance ledger.
